event.juno_heart2.0.text: Okay, okay, okay, hold the tongs, [player]. Both hands. They bite if you're shy.
event.juno_heart2.0.why: opens in her tic and puts the player to work at once

event.juno_heart2.1.text: See that color? Cherry going to straw. That's the moment. Bram calls it 'now'. I call it 'NOW!'
event.juno_heart2.1.why: specific craft and a Bram tease

event.juno_heart2.2.text: Here. Your first bars. Two, because one looked lonely.
event.juno_heart2.2.why: the gift, with a self-deflating tail

event.juno_heart5.0.text: Okay, okay, okay, I finished it! Eleven evenings. Bram fixed one rivet, and I pretended not to see.
event.juno_heart5.0.why: specific effort plus the quiet-fix running bit

event.juno_heart5.1.text: A steel sword. For the mines, or the weeds, or looking very serious on your porch. It's yours.

event.juno_heart5.2.text: Don't lose it! ...It's still Bram's pattern, though. The next one won't be. I just don't know what it is yet.
event.juno_heart5.2.why: turns the gift toward her want: an original piece

event.next_door.0.text: Okay, okay, okay. Eyes shut. Not yet. Not yet... Now!
event.next_door.0.why: builds the reveal in her rhythm

event.next_door.1.text: My own piece, with my own mark. It's a hinge. A plain one. The mark's crooked, and I love it more than breakfast!

dlg.next_door.talk.0.text: He brought the good tongs. The good tongs! Do I take them? Say something quick, before I do the opposite!
dlg.next_door.talk.0.why: reacts to Bram's offer and hands the choice over

dlg.next_door.talk.r0.text: One heat, together. ...Okay. Better. It's still mine, though. The tongs only held it.

dlg.next_door.talk.r1.text: My hands. Okay, okay. ...A hair thicker at the shoulder. I did that! Bram, I did that!

event.next_door.5.text: ...He said it. Out loud, with a witness. I need to sit. The empty shop next door has a bench. I've measured it. Twice.
event.next_door.5.why: lands the heard word, then points next door

event.hall_dance.8.text: Those door hinges are mine. My mark's on every pin. Listen to it swing. It's showing off, and I'm letting it!
event.hall_dance.8.why: her mark in public, proud and silly

event.story_notes_juno.intro.text: Don't look! ...Okay, you looked. Fine. Encouragement leaks out of me. I can't plug it.

dlg.story.notes.juno.0.text: Juno has a folded note halfway under a door. She stops. So do you.

dlg.story.notes.juno.1.text: ...So. Now you know. All of them were me. Mostly in pencil.

dlg.story.notes.juno.r0.text: ...You smiled. Okay. That's a lot of kindness for one face to hold.

dlg.story.notes.juno.r1.text: Oh. Oh no, that's the whole reward. I'm going to go be flustered behind the rain barrel.

dlg.story.notes.juno.r2.text: A note? For me? ...I'm keeping it. In a drawer I'm inventing right now. Label pending.

event.story_notes_juno.after.text: Don't tell Bram. He's had six. He keeps every one in his apron pocket. He thinks they're from Tilda.
event.story_notes_juno.after.why: a secret with Bram in it; leaves the player wanting to see him

dlg.story.band.talk.1.text: Exhibit B: three anvils, the wash bucket, and Bram, who has agreed to hit one thing. Once. Gently.
dlg.story.band.talk.1.why: the joke tightens on its last word

dlg.story.band.talk.r1.text: Okay, okay, okay! We won! Bram, we won! ...Bram? He's hitting the thing. Twice!
dlg.story.band.talk.r1.why: Bram's one hit becomes two: the payoff

event.juno_heart4.setup.text: Okay, okay, okay, don't move! Stay right there. I have a surprise, and it's very sticky.

event.juno_heart4.prank.text: Done! You're labeled! 'Guest (Excellent)'. Spelled right and everything. I'm so proud.

dlg.juno.label.0.text: So? Say something. Any answer except 'Hm.' I get enough of that at work.
dlg.juno.label.0.why: teases Bram, hands over the choice

dlg.juno.label.r0.text: Accepted! You're officially a fixture. I'll sweep around you and dust you on Fridays.

dlg.juno.label.r1.text: Relabel me? Brilliant. Here's the pencil. ...'Apprentice (Chaotic)'. Fair. Stick it right here.

dlg.juno.label.r2.text: You... ate it. You ate my label. ...I'm labeling this moment 'Do Not Repeat'. Please repeat it.

event.juno_heart4.reaction.text: {if choice:label.accept}A label that stays! Next I'm doing the whole village. The hall roof gets 'Nearly (Fixed)'.{else}{if choice:label.relabel}'Apprentice (Chaotic)', on my forehead, all day. Bram read it and nodded. Twice.{else}Nobody's ever eaten a label! I'm thrilled. I'm a little worried. I'm making a drawer that says 'Not Food'.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_heart4.reaction.why: each branch keeps its result; accept points at labeling the village

event.juno_heart6.intro.text: Don't come in. Okay, come in. Shut the door. I made something, it's crooked, and the quench barrel is looking at it.
event.juno_heart6.intro.why: panic, then the barrel as a threat

dlg.juno.strike.0.text: My first piece that isn't a copy of anything. A little horseshoe. It's lopsided. I made it. I hate how much I love it.
dlg.juno.strike.0.why: short sentences for a real feeling

dlg.juno.strike.1.text: So. Keep it, or the barrel? Quick, before my arm decides.
dlg.juno.strike.1.why: urgency, a hand ready to throw

dlg.juno.strike.r0.text: Keep it. Yes. Even crooked. ...Especially crooked.

dlg.juno.strike.r1.text: Together? Okay! You hold the tongs, I tap the bend. Okay, okay, okay, go!
dlg.juno.strike.r1.why: calls back to holding the tongs in heart 2

dlg.juno.strike.r2.text: It's very funny! A horseshoe for a three-legged horse. A very proud three-legged horse.
dlg.juno.strike.r2.why: laughs first so the fear can't

event.juno_heart6.after.text: It's still crooked. It's also still mine. That's new. ...Don't tell Bram yet. I have to pick the right day.
event.juno_heart6.after.why: drops the 'thank you' shape; points at showing Bram

event.juno_heart8.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay. I'm showing Bram the horseshoe. Now, before I lose my nerve. Stand next to me? I sweat less with company.
event.juno_heart8.intro.why: now rather than tonight, matching the scene's daytime

dlg.juno.shoe.0.text: Bram stands at the far end of the forge. Juno holds the horseshoe out in both hands and keeps her eyes on the floor.

dlg.juno.shoe.1.text: I can't look. What's his face doing? Is it the 'Hm' face or the other 'Hm' face?

dlg.juno.shoe.r0.text: ...Okay. Quiet's good. The anvil's being quiet too. Everyone is being so quiet.

dlg.juno.shoe.r1.text: Wonderful? It's crooked! ...But okay. I'm looking up now. Slowly. Very slowly.

dlg.juno.shoe.r2.text: The hammer? Okay. One more tap. For luck. For me. For crooked things everywhere.

event.juno_heart8.after.text: {if choice:shoe.wait}You waited. He's holding it now. He turned it over twice and hasn't said a word. It's the best word.{else}{if choice:shoe.praise}You said wonderful, and he's frowning at it like he agrees. That's how Bram says yes.{else}One last tap on the bend. It's better, and it's still mine. He hasn't put it down.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_heart8.after.why: each branch reads Bram's silence her way

event.juno_heart10.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay. Hold out your hand. I made a mark. My own. I stamped it on something before I told a single person.

event.juno_heart10.give.text: First thing with my mark on it. A tiny copper bar. {if quest:juno_gold=done}Copper on purpose: your gold went into the die. {/if}It's small. It's the biggest thing I've made.
event.juno_heart10.give.why: small object, big claim, last word true

event.juno_heart10.thanks.text: {if choice:shoe.wait}Bram saw the mark. He waited, like you did, then nodded once. Once! Next door has an empty sign hook.{else}Bram saw the mark and said 'Hm.' I'm framing it. The 'Hm.' Next door has an empty sign hook.{/if}
event.juno_heart10.thanks.why: Bram's response, then the next-door thread

event.juno_friend.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay, quick! Come see the swimming pool. It's a bucket. Wren named it. I made the sign.

event.juno_friend.doing.text: See? 'Swimming Pool (Official)'. Quench tried it once. Quench has opinions now.

event.juno_friend.wrap.text: Best pool in Wetherell. Only pool in Wetherell. Still a bucket. Thursdays are swim day, if you want a lane.
event.juno_friend.wrap.why: invites the player back on a named day

event.juno_birthday.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay, it's my birthday and I'm not nervous! I labeled the cake 'Cake (Birthday)', in case of confusion. Come in!

dlg.juno.birthday.c1.why: playful tease in the player's voice

dlg.juno.birthday.r0.text: Thank you! I'm framing that. The words. Don't tell Bram I frame words.
dlg.juno.birthday.r0.why: absurd reaction to a simple wish

dlg.juno.birthday.r1.text: It's a perfectly good label! ...Okay, it's too good. I'm going red. That's the forge.

dlg.juno.birthday.r2.text: A gift! For me! On purpose! I'm going to cry on a clasp. Again.
dlg.juno.birthday.r2.why: callback to crying on a clasp

event.juno_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.juno.wish}It's framed now, next to the first clasp that ever closed. Click is very proud.{else}{if choice:bday.juno.tease}The cake label stays. Bram added a second one underneath. It says 'Eat'.{else}A gift, from you, on my birthday. It's on the anvil. Everything else in here orbits it now.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_birthday.after.why: branches kept; wish calls back the clasp named Click

event.juno_courtship.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay. I made a list. 'Reasons I Like the Farmer.' Forty items. I'd read it, but I'd faint. So. Would you court me?

dlg.juno.courtship.0.text: My ears are hot. Say something before I label them.
dlg.juno.courtship.0.why: nerves in her bit instead of a bare question

dlg.juno.courtship.c0.why: warm yes; works in both asks

dlg.juno.courtship.r0.text: Yes? YES. Okay. I need a minute, and also a hammer. Courting! You and me!

dlg.juno.courtship.r1.text: Friends! Oh. Okay! Good! The best kind! ...I'll label it 'Friends (Very Good)'. Thank you for saying it straight.
dlg.juno.courtship.r1.why: takes it bravely, label as cover

dlg.juno.courtship.r2.text: Think! Yes! Take your time! I'll be right here, polishing one clasp very slowly, not watching the door.

event.juno_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.juno.yes}Courting! Bram says I'm vibrating. I am. The tongs are vibrating. Thank you!{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.juno.friends}Friends, labeled, on the shelf next to the first clasp. That's the good shelf.{else}Take your time. I'll start item forty-one. It's 'patient'.{/if}{/if}

event.juno_courtship2.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay. The list has forty-one items now. Forty-one is 'patient'. I've been so patient! So. Would you court me?
event.juno_courtship2.intro.why: asks again, calling back item forty-one

event.juno_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.juno.yes}Courting! Finally! Bram says I'm vibrating. I am. Thank you!{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.juno.friends}Friends, labeled, on the shelf next to the first clasp. That's the good shelf.{else}Take your time. Item forty-two is 'still patient'. It's underlined.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_courtship2.after.why: second ask has its own later-branch

event.juno_partners.intro.text: Hi! Hi, hi! I made you something. Four hours, zero nerves. It's a tiny anvil for your desk. It does nothing!

dlg.juno.partners.0.text: Okay, okay, okay. Forge is banked, evening's free. What are we doing?

dlg.juno.partners.r0.text: It's perfect, right? It rings if you tap it with a pin. I tested it twice. Once on Bram.

dlg.juno.partners.r1.text: The beach! With sand! I'll bring a clasp for luck, and a sandwich. Not for the clasp.

dlg.juno.partners.r2.text: Okay. Yes. Hands. I'm very warm. That's the forge. Definitely the forge. Don't let go.

event.juno_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.juno.anvil}The tiny anvil's on my bench now. Most important tool I own. Still does nothing. Perfectly.{else}{if choice:courtship.juno.beach}The beach was perfect. I got sand in a clasp. It crunches now. I'm keeping it.{else}Hands, at the forge. Bram pretended not to see. Then he smiled at the coal. I saw.{/if}{/if}

event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l1.text: Bram! I labeled the tongs! 'Tongs (Left)' and 'Tongs (Right)'. Same tongs.

event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l3.text: That's what labels are for! So everyone else knows too!

event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l1.text: Bram. Did you put a second label on my cake? It just says 'Eat'.

event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l3.text: That's the nicest label anyone's ever made me, and I make all the labels!

event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l1.text: Bram! I'm on your bench again. I fixed its wobbly leg myself. The joint's crooked. Don't look.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l1.why: makes Bram's 'best joint' reply make sense

event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l3.text: Wait. Was that a compliment? Bram. Was that a compliment? I need a minute.

event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l1.text: Bram. Someday I'll have my own forge. A tiny one. Maybe next door.

event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l3.text: You would? You'd sit on my bench? Even the crooked one?

event.overheard_piper_juno_1.l2.text: Quieter? Piper, it's a forge! You're supposed to feel it!

event.overheard_piper_juno_1.l4.text: Then the anvil has a fan! Tell your teeth I said thanks!

event.overheard_piper_juno_2.l2.text: You did? Play it! No, wait, I'll keep time! Okay, go!

event.overheard_piper_juno_2.l4.text: That's a hit! I'm labeling it 'Song (Forge)' and hammering it all week!

event.overheard_piper_juno_3.l2.text: It says 'Stage (Piper)'! Official! Play on it! I sanded the splinters!

event.overheard_piper_juno_3.l4.text: Okay! No, I'll hammer! No, I'll watch! Both! Always both!

event.overheard_tilda_juno_1.l1.text: Tilda! Slate payment! Three clasps and one hinge with a smiley face stamped on.

event.overheard_tilda_juno_1.l3.text: Is the smiley face worth extra? It took me an hour.

event.overheard_tilda_juno_2.l2.text: I still can't! I stand on the flour sack now.

event.overheard_tilda_juno_2.l4.text: Years? Tilda, that's going on my slate. Under 'Owed (Forever)'.
event.overheard_tilda_juno_2.l4.why: turns Tilda's slate into her label

event.overheard_tilda_juno_3.l1.text: Tilda... if I ever had my own forge, a small one, would you still feed me?

event.overheard_tilda_juno_3.l3.text: In Wetherell. Definitely. Next door to Bram. Probably. Okay, definitely.

adds.text: Quench it! ...Hear that hiss? That's the bar saying thank you. Or ow. Same word, in iron.
adds.why: gives the stub a middle beat: the player makes something with her

adds.text: Bram's mark is on every bar in here. Mine's still a sketch. A lot of sketches. They live under the coal.
adds.why: plants her own mark as the thread

adds.text: I polished the flat until I could see my own nose in it. Nine times. Ten.
adds.why: a concrete brag that deflates itself

threads.juno_heart2: Juno keeps sketches of her own maker's mark hidden under the coal; what will it look like?
threads.juno_heart5: Her next piece won't be a copy of Bram's; she doesn't know what it will be.
threads.next_door: Juno has already measured the empty shop next door; when does she move in?
threads.story_notes_juno: Bram keeps six of her notes in his apron and thinks Tilda wrote them.
threads.juno_heart4: Juno plans to label the whole village next, starting with the hall roof.
threads.juno_heart6: When will Juno show Bram the crooked horseshoe?
threads.juno_heart8: Bram is holding her horseshoe and still hasn't said the word she wants.
threads.juno_heart10: The empty sign hook next door is waiting for Juno's mark.
threads.juno_friend: Thursday is swim day at the bucket; will the player claim a lane?
threads.juno_birthday: Bram quietly added his own label to her cake.
threads.juno_courtship: Item forty-one on her list is 'patient'; she is waiting for an answer.
threads.juno_courtship2: Her list keeps growing while she waits.
threads.juno_partners: Bram saw, and said nothing; what will he say to her later?
threads.overheard_juno_bram_1: Someone has put a label on Bram's hat.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_2: Bram is quietly learning her labels.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_3: Bram praised her work out loud; she wants more of it.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_4: Juno's tiny forge, next door, with Bram on the bench.
threads.overheard_piper_juno_1: Piper's ballad versus the anvil; who wins next?
threads.overheard_piper_juno_2: A forge song exists now; will the village learn it?
threads.overheard_piper_juno_3: Piper has a stage of her own now.

notes: juno_heart8: card intro said 'Tonight I show it to Bram' but the scene plays 9-17 with Bram present; I made it 'now'. Bram's heart 8 should match (bible calls it 'the same night').
story_notes_juno.after: new fact that Bram keeps six of her notes in his apron and thinks they're from Tilda; Bram's writer should know (or veto).
overheard_juno_bram_3.l1: changed 'carved a small mistake' to fixing the bench's wobbly leg so Bram's 'Best joint in the shop' makes sense.
dlg.juno.courtship.* keys are shared by juno_courtship and juno_courtship2; c0 changed from 'Forty items is a lot' to 'Read me the list' so it fits the second ask (forty-one items).
next_door and juno_heart10 both point at the empty shop next door (measured bench, empty sign hook): one consistent thread.
